pages.title: The Bow Stayed Dry
pages.text: Use an underwater bow’s trajectory and distinct aquatic support.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain fires axolotls; Grace protects a bubble column with an axolotl and Resistance; Bounty creates a swarm; Chaos sends a damaging knockback wave.
